protocol: Leave-one-positive-region-out: pool = held-out region + all non-positive regions; relevant = held-out region only. Mission distance uses spec tolerances, so no scale is fitted on the pool.
caveat: Positive labels are known-analog roles, not proof of analogy for this experiment; on synthetic data this checks code logic only, not scientific accuracy.

noise_model: Independent Gaussian per (trial, cell, feature) with the cell's reported 1-sigma; assumed sigma (slope 1°, roughness 0.05 m, shadow 0.03) where unreported.
